verdict.rationale: DPMA is Germany's national patent and trade mark office. Its online services (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb/Pro) are front-ends to a sovereign registry whose records the authority holds itself, so letting a user choose a storage region is a category error for this kind of product. Forwarding an application to the EPA or WIPO is a filing route, not a data-residency choice, and nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
